department: Infrastructure and Environmental Systems (INES) PhD program

deadline.value: The INES pages give no application deadline; the Graduate School's dates apply.

gre_general.value: GRE scores in the upper 50th percentile are expected, but not required for applicants with a graduate GPA of 3.65 or above.
gre_general.quote: Acceptable scores on the verbal, quantitative and analytical sections of the Graduate Record Examination (GRE) are expected to be in the upper 50th percentile

also.quote: However, GRE is not required for applicants who earn a graduate GPA of 3.65 or above

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The admission pages do not say whether a faculty agreement is needed before admission.

funding.value: All full-time doctoral students receive tuition awards and health benefits, with graduate assistantships competitively awarded on top.
funding.quote: All full-time doctoral students receive robust financial assistance, including comprehensive tuition awards and health benefits

entry_route.value: Bachelor's holders need an undergraduate GPA of 3.75 for the regular track; master's holders with a 3.50 GPA are admitted.
entry_route.quote: Applicants holding only baccalaureate degrees with an undergraduate GPA of 3.75 or above may be considered for admission into the regular track

notes: The Civil Engineering, Ph.D. page could not be read: the Civil and Environmental Engineering pages redirect to a college landing page and the catalog returned a 502 error, so this civil record covers the INES program only. The INES program requires 72 credits for bachelor's holders and 42 for master's holders.
name: Infrastructure and Environmental Systems, Ph.D.
